company.name: Hebbia
company.shortDescription: Hebbia is an artificial intelligence platform designed to assist investment banking, asset management, and corporate strategy teams.
company.description: Hebbia's core software application, Matrix, ingests unstructured information from corporate document repositories, financial filings, expert transcripts, and virtual data rooms to index facts into auditable knowledge charts. The system utilizes multi-agent orchestration to automate sequential administrative processes, enabling users to construct comparison tables, generate investment research reports, and track compliance documentation.

productsAndServices.description: An AI platform for finance and other information-intensive organizations that analyzes private documents, public filings, and financial data to support research, due diligence, and decision-making.

aiResearchSummary.text: Hebbia is researching a matrix user interface for LLM powered data analysis and generation, described as a data analytics system that uses a grid based data structure to improve usability of large language models in analyzing large data sets, synthesizing information for generative AI contexts, and enhancing user interaction with an LLM. Its work centers on grid based data interaction, LLM driven analysis, generative synthesis, and improved human AI interfaces.
